content_max_chars.description: Truncate each entry's `content` to the first N characters (a preview). Omit for the full body. Ignored when `keys_only=true`.

date_from.description: ISO-8601 inclusive lower bound on `updated_at`. Omit to skip the lower bound.

date_to.description: ISO-8601 exclusive upper bound on `updated_at`. Pass to walk back past the result cap on subsequent calls (cursor-style: set to the `updated_at` of the oldest entry from the prior page).

include_expired.description: Include entries whose `expires_at` has passed. Off by default so a time-boxed memory retires itself; turn it on to audit what the fleet remembered and when it lapsed.

include_revisions.description: With `key`, also return the entry's earlier versions, newest first: what each `remember` that changed it replaced, and what a `forget` deleted, with who changed it and when. Versions are kept for two weeks, at most 10 per key. Works for a deleted key too. To restore one, `remember` its content.

key.description: Exact key match — returns the single entry with this key, or nothing. Use this to re-read a known entry; `text` searches key *and* content, so it can push the row you asked for past the limit. An entry hidden only by its expiry comes back with `expired=true` and a blank `content`, and every entry it returns carries `last_changed_by_skill` / `last_changed_at`.

key_prefix.description: Return only the entries whose key starts with this prefix, case-sensitive, with `%` and `_` matched literally. Use it to read one family of keys, such as `followup:<skill-name>:`; unlike `text`, it ignores what entry bodies say. Combines with every other filter.

keys_only.description: When true, blank each entry's `content` and return only keys + metadata. Use to scan which memories exist without pulling their (potentially large) bodies, then re-query the ones worth a full read. Takes precedence over `content_max_chars`.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 20, hard cap 1000).

skill_name.description: Return only the entries this writer created, matched against `created_by_skill` (a scout skill name or a `pipeline:*` identity). Omit to return entries from every writer.

text.description: ILIKE substring match against `content` and `key`. Must contain 3 letters or digits in a row, or 2 next to a symbol such as `ai_` or `pr:`. Omit to return the most recent entries.
